name: Шахта: прожекторы в пыли
about: Промышленный масштаб под землёй: конусы прожекторов в висящей пыли, мокрый камень, тросы и вагонетки, фигуры мелко у основания забоя. Прямо под шахты Ликоса.
style_notes_en: painterly digital concept art with photographic weight, rendered as a film keyframe rather than a photograph or a classical painting; practical light sources visible or implied inside the frame; full value range down to true black; visible brush economy on metal and fabric while the focal object holds crisp detail; worn lived-in objects — mugs, taped paper, handwritten notes, scuffed panels — rendered with the same care as the machinery; desaturated palette split warm against cool; wide cinematic framing with foreground objects cropped by the frame edge; an underground industrial scale, floodlight cones cutting through hanging dust, wet rock face, cables, rails and ore cars, small figures at the foot of the working face for scale, palette of coal black, wet slate and one harsh white light
